title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for the work done in changing the separation of the capacitor plates must be provided.

title: Capacitance Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the capacitance of the parallel-plate capacitor as C = ε0 π r^2 / d.

title: Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the initial and final stored energy in the capacitor.

title: Change in Energy
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly find the change in energy stored in the capacitor as a function of d and d'.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common sign mistakes in the final expression for work done.
